newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Liberty Press to launch on line service.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Liberty Press to launch on line service.

text.p: Liberty Press Group, publisher of the National Business Review, said on Friday it would soon launch an on-line service which would allow users to conduct a broad range of transactions through the Internet.
NBR Business Centre Online will house 26 sites and provide 120 services, Liberty Press said.
The service would allow Internet users to buy parcels of shares, assess property investments, carry out credit record checks, place and amend classified ads and apply for jobs.
Liberty Press Chairman Barry Colman said in a statement he expected the centre to become one of New Zealand's most visited web sites. The centre is to be launched on Wednesday.
